title: Coherence of tensor restriction comparisons under chart refinement
statement: Let X,Y,Z,W be schemes [def-pc-scheme], q:Y→X, v:Z→X, h:W→X, pk:W→Y and pl:W→Z with pk≫q=h and pl≫v=h. Let U be an open cover of X and a a cover index. Set Uk=U pulled back along q, Ul=U pulled back along v, Vk=Uk pulled back along pk and Vl=Ul pulled back along pl. Supply d:Ul(a)→Uk(a) commuting with the maps to U(a), and z:Vl(a)→Vk(a) with z≫(Vk→Uk)=(Vl→Ul)≫d and z≫(Vk→W)=Vl→W. For ordinary module pullback [def-pc-module-pullback], write D=d*, Pk=(Vk→Uk)*, Pl=(Vl→Ul)*, Zf=z*, Rk=(Vk→W)* and Rl=(Vl→W)*; put Lk=q* followed by restriction to Uk(a), Ll=v* followed by restriction to Ul(a), where q*,v*,h* denote tensor pullback. Define alpha:Ll≅Lk⋙D using the restriction comparisons [def-pc-open-cover-tensor-pullback-comparison] and ordinary pullback composition along d; beta:Rk⋙Zf≅Rl using ordinary composition and the equation to W; delta:Pk⋙Zf≅D⋙Pl using ordinary composition and the refinement square. Define ck:h*⋙Rk≅Lk⋙Pk and cl:h*⋙Rl≅Ll⋙Pl by tensor composition [def-pc-tensor-pullback-composition-iso] followed by inverse restriction comparison. Then for every X-module M, Zf(ck_M)≫delta_(Lk M)≫Pl(alpha_M inverse)=beta_(h* M)≫cl_M. All comparisons are the explicit composition/congruence expressions in the Lean statement, rather than arbitrary isomorphisms. The five comparison isomorphisms are bundled by [def-pc-open-cover-refinement-comparisons].

source.place: Tags 0095 and 0096, functoriality of pullback; expanded canonical-comparison coherence step of lem-pc-open-cover-map-lift-transport, proof step 2

proof.text: Derive Hk and Hl from the cover projection equations and wk,wl. Apply the single tensor recovery normalization to the k and l factorizations, with all supplied comparisons identified by reflexivity.

Apply the ordinary pullback refinement coherence to U(a)→X, the two chart projection paths, d and z. The beta and delta comparisons are exactly the corresponding projections of openCoverRefinementComparisons.

Write alpha as tl inverse, then gamma, then whiskered tk. Postcompose the desired equation with Pl(tl inverse), which is an isomorphism. Cancel tl with its inverse; use naturality of delta to move tk inverse past delta. Apply k-normalization and the ordinary coherence, then naturality of beta for the unique h-comparison. Apply l-normalization in reverse and cancel the final isomorphism. These are the explicit Lean calc steps, with no further admitted glue.

proof_origin.note: The original mate normalization and ordinary reassociation steps are separately stated; the combination by naturality and cancellation is fully formalized.

lean.statement:
theorem openCover_tensor_comparison_coherence
    {X Y Z W : Scheme.{u}} (q : Y ⟶ X) (v : Z ⟶ X) (h : W ⟶ X)
    (pk : W ⟶ Y) (pl : W ⟶ Z) (wk : pk ≫ q = h) (wl : pl ≫ v = h)
    (U : X.OpenCover.{u}) (a : U.I₀)
    (d : (U.pullback₁ v).X a ⟶ (U.pullback₁ q).X a)
    (hd : d ≫ U.pullbackHom q a = U.pullbackHom v a)
    (z : ((U.pullback₁ v).pullback₁ pl).X a ⟶
      ((U.pullback₁ q).pullback₁ pk).X a)
    (hz : z ≫ Scheme.Cover.pullbackHom (U.pullback₁ q) pk a =
      Scheme.Cover.pullbackHom (U.pullback₁ v) pl a ≫ d)
    (hz0 : z ≫ ((U.pullback₁ q).pullback₁ pk).f a =
      ((U.pullback₁ v).pullback₁ pl).f a)
    (M : X.Modules) :
    let Uk : Y.OpenCover.{u} := U.pullback₁ q
    let Ul : Z.OpenCover.{u} := U.pullback₁ v
    let Vk : W.OpenCover.{u} := Uk.pullback₁ pk
    let Vl : W.OpenCover.{u} := Ul.pullback₁ pl
    let D := pullback d
    let Pk := pullback (Uk.pullbackHom pk a)
    let Pl := pullback (Ul.pullbackHom pl a)
    let Zf := pullback z
    let Rk := pullback (Vk.f a)
    let Rl := pullback (Vl.f a)
    let Lk := tensorPullback q ⋙ pullback (Uk.f a)
    let Ll := tensorPullback v ⋙ pullback (Ul.f a)
    let comparisons := openCoverRefinementComparisons q v h pk pl wk wl U a d hd z hz hz0
    let alpha := comparisons.1
    let beta := comparisons.2.1
    let delta := comparisons.2.2.1
    let ck := moduleRecoveryComparisonIso (tensorPullback h) (tensorPullback q)
      (tensorPullback pk) (pullback (Uk.f a)) Pk Rk
      (tensorPullbackCompositionIso pk q h wk) (openCoverTensorPullbackComparison pk Uk a)
    let cl := moduleRecoveryComparisonIso (tensorPullback h) (tensorPullback v)
      (tensorPullback pl) (pullback (Ul.f a)) Pl Rl
      (tensorPullbackCompositionIso pl v h wl) (openCoverTensorPullbackComparison pl Ul a)
    Zf.map (ck.hom.app M) ≫ delta.hom.app (Lk.obj M) ≫
      Pl.map (alpha.inv.app M) = beta.hom.app ((tensorPullback h).obj M) ≫
        cl.hom.app M
